parameters.name: DiscoverInitialTimeout
parameters.description: Initial delay, expressed in {{units}}, before initiating the first DCHCPDISCOVER message.

parameters.name: DiscoverMaxTimeout
parameters.description: Maximum duration, expressed in {{units}}, between two DHCPDISCOVER message retransmission. According to {{bibref|RFC2131|Chapter 4.1}}, the recommended value for this parameter is 64 {{units}}.

parameters.name: DiscoverMaxDuration
parameters.description: Maximum duration, expressed in {{units}}, during which the DHCPv4 client is permitted to retransmit DHCPDISCOVER message A value of '0' indicates that no specific maximum duration is set.

parameters.name: RequestInitialTimeout
parameters.description: Initial delay, expressed in {{units}}, before initiating the first DHCPREQUEST message.

parameters.name: RequestMaxTimeout
parameters.description: Maximum duration, expressed in {{units}}, between two DHCPREQUEST message retransmission. According to {{bibref|RFC2131|Chapter 4.1}}, the recommended value for this parameter is 64 {{units}}.

parameters.name: RequestMaxDuration
parameters.description: Maximum duration, expressed in {{units}}, during which the DHCPv4 client is permitted to retransmit DHCPREQUEST message. A value of '0' indicates that no specific maximum duration is set.

parameters.name: TimeoutRandomize
parameters.description: The Randomization factor for the retransmission timeout, in {{units}}, as defined in {{bibref|RFC2131|4.1 Constructing and sending DHCP messages}}. E.g. a timeout of 2000ms with a randomization of 1000 will end up between 1000 and 3000 ms.

object.description: This object enables the configurion of the DHCPv4 retransmission behavior according to the guidelines described in {{bibref|RFC2131|Chapter 4.1}}.
